This file contains the security configuration for the Spring Boot application. It extends WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter to set up the security policies. It disables Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) protection for the application and allows all requests to the '/actuator/**' endpoints for monitoring and health checks, while enforcing authentication for all other requests. The configuration uses HTTP Basic Authentication to secure the endpoints that require user authentication, ensuring that sensitive operations remain protected.
